audience: HR administrators and team leads who check leave, vacation and timesheets in AlexisHR

useCases.title: See who is on leave in a period
useCases.text: List leave requests filtered by employee, status or start-date range. Read the leave types to see which ones are paid.

useCases.title: Check vacation balances for a department
useCases.text: List the employees of a department. Then get the vacation balance of each employee: available days and cycle dates.

useCases.title: Find people hired in one office
useCases.text: List the offices to find one. Then list employees and check the office, manager and hire date of each.

useCases.title: Review timesheets waiting for approval
useCases.text: List timesheets filtered by status and period, with their approver. List the time entries of one timesheet.

useCases.title: Get the projects, teams and cost centres
useCases.text: List projects with their codes and leads, plus the teams and cost centres of the account.
